scientific_integrity: Complete finite proof is based on an explicit acyclic discrete-Morse matching, unimodular integral attaching map, and an exhaustive 1,920-element signed Lefschetz computation. The standalone verifier is included. Mathematical audit by an independent party has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: This establishes the integral homotopy type and integral top-homology orientation character only for the 5-regular 16-vertex Clebsch graph at parameter two. It does not classify larger folded cubes, integral quotient torsion, or equivariant homotopy type. Unindexed equivalent work remains possible.
title: The Clebsch two-independence complex is a four-sphere with sign orientation
